meta.name: Bhalla Calling Bhalla
meta.description: Meet the Bhallas who are stuck in different cities during the lockdown. Watch how the family stays connected and finds joy even in social distancing.

videos.title: Lockdown
videos.overview: Lovely Bhalla is all excited about her birthday just when the lockdown is announced. Her husband and kids who are stuck in different cities are unable to reach home. How will Lovely celebrate her birthday?

videos.title: Birthday Blues
videos.overview: Lovely is happy that her brother Gogi remembered her birthday but loses her cool when she comes to know that her gift has come from a place where a corona positive patient was found. Gogi call up the other family members and reminds them about Lovely’s birthday and all start wishing her.

videos.title: Withdrawal Symptoms
videos.overview: It's been a week into the lockdown and all are struggling. Mr. Bhalla is troubled by constipation, Sahil goes into depression and Lissa struggles with her daily chores. Its Mrs Lovely Bhalla who comes to rescue them. However, Mrs Bhalla loses her cool when Sahil gets caught with a girl.

videos.title: Care to Share
videos.overview: Saahil is guilty that his mother is hurt and he tries to cover up the issue but to his surprise Lovely starts liking Neha. Meanwhile, Gogi plays Naarad and tries his tactics to provoke all family members against each other. Will his plan work?
